verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail advertises 'automation rules' for mail handling and API/Zapier access for building custom workflows, which could support recurring automations, but there is no documented native scheduler, cron-like job system, or explicit recurring-workflow feature — automation depth relies entirely on external tools like Zapier. missing for 10: native recurring job/scheduler documentation, examples of scheduled workflows, independent confirmation of automation rule capabilities beyond marketing copy.
